t: A low-cost Raspberry Pi Pico carrier with a light on every pin.
steps: Buy the Maker Pi Pico from Cytron, RobotShop or the Base version from Adafruit.
Plug your own Pico into the Base version, or use the one already soldered on.
Connect the Pico to your computer with a micro USB cable.
Install the free Thonny or Mu editor.
Load CircuitPython from the CircuitPython website on a bare Pico.
Open the Cytron example repo and copy the blink example.
Run it and watch the pin lights flash in a row.
meta: Open Board. From $9.95. A few stores.
